conditions.message: 1 of 2 engines run bundle 7 or later
conditions.cause: Some engines don't run the bundle yet, or a proxy pod that serves the policy has an engine that isn't connected (starting or reconnecting), or, for a policy whose proxy pods the operator doesn't know (raw Envoy, the standalone proxy), an engine outside the integrations' pods that disconnected in the last 2 minutes, and whose pod still exists, hadn't run its current version (it keeps its older bundle until it reconnects).
conditions.fix: Usually seconds; if it lasts, `inkwallctl status` names them; check that the pod's engine reaches the operator (InkwallEngineDisconnected (docs/monitoring.md#inkwallenginedisconnected)).
